summary: Market leadership comes down to two things: the vision to anticipate and solve customer problems and proven engineering execution. Across AI Security,

[Announcement](https://www.paloaltonetworks.com/blog/category/announcement/)


[Products and Services](https://www.paloaltonetworks.com/blog/category/products-and-services/)


[Forrester Wave](https://www.paloaltonetworks.com/blog/tag/forrester-wave/)


[Gartner Magic Quadrant](https://www.paloaltonetworks.com/blog/tag/gartner-magic-quadrant/)


[IDC](https://www.paloaltonetworks.com/blog/tag/idc/)


[Omdia](https://www.paloaltonetworks.com/blog/tag/omdia/)


Market leadership comes down to two things: the vision to anticipate and solve customer problems and proven engineering execution. Across AI Security, Network Security, SASE, and critical infrastructure protection the industry’s top analyst firms continue to recognize Palo Alto Networks for its product and innovation excellence.


Here are some major analyst recognitions that underscore our position at the forefront of the industry:


- **Named a**[Market Shaper in Gartner® Emerging Market Quadrant for AI Application Security:](https://www.paloaltonetworks.com/blog/2026/09/defining-the-standard-for-ai-security/) **** Gartner defines ‘Market Shapers' as those that are building comprehensive platforms by acquiring innovative companies and introducing centralized management tools for AI workflows. They are also expanding traditional security capabilities into broader agent-based controls, using advanced access control and runtime monitoring to secure agentic actions.


- [Leader in Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Hybrid Mesh Firewall:](https://www.paloaltonetworks.com/blog/2026/09/palo-alto-networks-named-a-leader-in-the-2026-gartner-magic-quadrant-for-hybrid-mesh-firewall-securing-every-environment-at-the-speed-of-frontier-ai/) Leeader for the


**second** **consecutive** time and positioned furthest in Completeness of Vision. We continue to advance hybrid mesh firewall with an integrated network security platform for preemptive protection, agentic operations, AI runtime security, and quantum-safe security across hybrid environments.


- [Only 4x Leader in Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for SASE Platforms & SSE:](https://www.paloaltonetworks.com/blog/2026/08/palo-alto-networks-recognized-as-the-only-4x-leader-in-sase-and-sse-gartner-magic-quadrants/) Palo Alto Networks was named a Leader for the fourth consecutive year in both the 2026 Gartner Magic Quadrant for Security Service Edge (SSE) and SASE Platforms. For SSE, we were placed highest in


**Ability to Execute** and furthest in


**Completeness of Vision.**


- [Named a Leader in The Forrester Wave™ Operational Technology Security Solutions, Q3 2026:](https://www.paloaltonetworks.com/blog/network-security/palo-alto-networks-named-a-leader-in-the-forrester-wave-operational-technology-security-solutions-q3-2026/) Palo Alto Networks was named a Leader across 11 providers and 21 criteria. The report stated “Palo Alto’s strategy in OT security is balanced with a solid vision toward platformization, leading to innovation and roadmaps built to drive this vision.”


- [Gartner® "Company to Beat" in AI Network Security for Telcos:](https://www.paloaltonetworks.com/blog/network-security/gartner-named-palo-alto-networks-as-a-company-to-beat-in-ai-network-security-for-telcos-as-of-july-2026/) Expanding our AI leadership into critical service provider environments, Gartner designated Palo Alto Networks as the "Company to Beat" for Telcos, driven by our 5G-Native Security, mobile-identity-aware controls, and embedded AI gateways.


- [Named a Visionary Leader in the Frost Radar: Healthcare Infrastructure Cybersecurity, United States, 2026:](https://www.paloaltonetworks.com/blog/network-security/palo-alto-networks-named-a-visionary-leader-in-the-frost-radar-healthcare-infrastructure-cybersecurity-united-states-2026/) The report fielded more than 50 qualified participants, and only Palo Alto Networks led on both the Growth and Innovation axes. The report noted “Its broad platform combines healthcare-specific device intelligence and virtual patching with network, cloud, identity, application, and AI security …”


- [Leader in 2026 IDC MarketScape for SASE:](https://www.paloaltonetworks.com/resources/research/palo-alto-networks-named-leader-in-the-idc-marketscape-for-sase) Palo Alto Networks’ Prisma SASE solution unifies networking, security, data protection, and operations into an agentic, single vendor, cloud-delivered platform. Driven by Precision AI, Strata Cloud Manager and Unit 42 threat intelligence, it offers advanced AI-driven, autonomous security enforcement to safeguard GenAI and agentic workflows..


- [Named Gartner® "Company to Beat" in AI Security Platforms (2nd Consecutive Year):](https://www.paloaltonetworks.com/blog/ai-security/palo-alto-networks-named-company-to-beat-in-ai-security-for-second-consecutive-year/) Gartner recognized Palo Alto Networks as the “Company to Beat” in AI Security, highlighting Prisma AIRS’ AI security control plane, agentic AI security, AI Gateway governance, and agent identity.


- [Omdia Named Palo Alto Networks a Leader in its Market Radar: OT Cybersecurity Platforms, 2026:](https://www.paloaltonetworks.com/blog/network-security/palo-alto-networks-named-a-leader-in-the-2026-omdia-market-radar-for-ot-cybersecurity/) Omdia scored thirteen capability areas across the market with our profile earning an advanced rating in seven of them. The report highlighted our strength in AI security, citing “Palo Alto Networks is one of the few vendors in this report that can support across Omdia’s entire AI security framework…”


## Winning Through Innovation and Execution


These analyst recognitions aren’t happening in a vacuum. They validate our focus to deliver real customer value. We are actively focused on defining the security platform for the Frontier AI era. Our momentum is driven by our commitment to solve the hardest security challenges on behalf of our customers.


- **Securing AI from Coding to Enterprise Agents:** Securing the AI enterprise starts with securing how employees and developers use AI coding assistants, apps, and agents across endpoints, browsers, SaaS, and cloud environments. With


[Prisma AIRS](https://www.paloaltonetworks.com/ai-security/prisma-airs) , enterprises gain an end-to-end AI security platform anchored by the


**AI Gateway as the enterprise AI control plane** , providing visibility and governance across models, agents, tools, and MCP connections, while combining AI supply chain, runtime, and agent security. Prisma AIRS enables organizations to accelerate AI coding and autonomous workflows with centralized policy enforcement, observability, and protection.


- **Advancing Network Security for the Frontier AI Era with PAN-OS 12.2 Ceres** : Our innovation leadership extends across the network - from enterprise and AI infrastructure to critical OT environments. PAN-OS 12.2 Ceres delivers 55+ innovations, including Frontier Virtual Patching, Advanced IP Defense, and Network Security Agents. Read the full list


[here](https://www.paloaltonetworks.com/blog/2026/08/redefining-network-security-for-the-frontier-ai-era/) .


- **Pioneering Agentic SASE for the Modern Workforce:** As AI agents become a key part of the new workforce, securing their access to data and applications is paramount. We are pioneering the first-ever Agentic SASE, evolving Prisma SASE to secure the massive scale of machine-to-machine and agent-to-app communication.


## Setting the Trajectory for Tomorrow


As AI coding, autonomous agents, and machine-speed operations reshape the enterprise, security has to keep pace. That means governing AI use, protecting agent activity, and using capabilities like Frontier Virtual Patching to reduce exposure.


Our focus is to give customers a consistent platform approach to secure AI, users, applications, and infrastructure without adding more fragmentation or complexity. That is the value of sustained innovation and execution: customers can move faster with AI without letting security become the bottleneck.


Market leadership and analyst recognition reflect the landscape today. But our focus remains firmly on where our customers are going. We ensure that our customers can meet or exceed expected outcomes by continuing to expand our network security platform to solve new business challenges and fend off even the most advanced attacks.
